assumptions: NEB's published percent activities and flags hold for the products named.
One tube: the buffer is scored on the worst enzyme's activity.
limits: NEB products only; another supplier's enzyme of the same name may differ.
Enzymes needing different temperatures are reported as such, not reconciled.
bio.jane/contract.noReading: The buffer, temperature, cofactor and inactivation rows the Reaction conditions block prints; the cautions a reaction earns are part of the digest's own reading, on digest_fragments.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which buffer, temperature, cofactors and heat inactivation does a digest with these enzymes need, by NEB's own data?

description: The reaction a digest needs, from NEB's own data: the NEBuffer that serves every enzyme together (scored on the WORST enzyme's percent activity, a star-activity buffer disqualified at any percent), the incubation temperature(s), any cofactor that must be added (SAM or ATP), and each product's heat-inactivation step, or the products NEB cannot heat-inactivate. One call is one tube: enzymes that need different temperatures or have no common buffer come back with `singleTube: false`. Needs no open record.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

enzymes.description: enzymes or NEB product names in one tube (EcoRI, BamHI-HF). A name NEB does not sell is returned under `unknown`, never dropped. Left unset, the run uses your active enzyme collection.

name: digest_reaction_conditions

buffer.description: the recommended NEBuffer, or null when every buffer is starred or at 0% for one of the enzymes

buffers.description: every NEBuffer scored, best first: worst percent, star-active enzymes, usable, per-enzyme activity

cofactors.description: cofactors the reaction requires (SAM, ATP), from REBASE

heatInactivation.description: whether the tube can be heat-killed, each product's NEB step (temperature, minutes), and the products that need a column or gel cleanup instead

singleTube.description: true when one buffer AND one temperature serve every enzyme

temperaturesC.description: incubation temperatures required, ascending; more than one means more than one step

unknown.description: names NEB does not sell, so no conditions exist for them
